tables.label: Tables
tables.title: Table performance · experimental
tables.description: Experimental relative rating from table components, not whole-document totals. At least two comparison families and a path to the main comparison group are required. Family counts do not establish independent datasets or statistical confidence. TEDS-S and the clean/digital PureDoc columns are diagnostic only.

panels.label: Table TEDS
panels.note: Full v1.6 table component; not the overall score or TEDS-S.

panels.label: Table structure TEDS-S
panels.note: Structure-only diagnostic; does not add a second OmniDoc vote.

panels.label: Real-degradation table TEDS
panels.note: Real-degradation track only. Clean and digital tracks are not averaged into this score.

panels.label: Clean table TEDS
panels.note: Clean-track diagnostic; no additional PureDoc rating vote.

panels.label: Digital-degradation table TEDS
panels.note: Digital-degradation diagnostic; no additional PureDoc rating vote.

panels.label: Reported table component
panels.note: Source-native table ratio. Source execution and page-exclusion caveats remain applicable.

panels.label: Published table component
panels.note: Published 9af4102 panel, not a matched throughput run. Scorer/pipeline caveats remain applicable.

panels.label: Table-category tests
panels.note: Table-category rule pass rate, not TEDS. Compared only inside the full olmOCR protocol.

panels.label: Table component
panels.note: Vendor-operated IDP table component; not an independent reproduction.

panels.label: Table component
panels.note: Retains source execution/reused-baseline qualifications.

panels.label: Table component
panels.note: Related benchmark families can share evaluation conventions or data; do not interpret family counts as independence.

panels.label: Table component
panels.note: Exact four-category author protocol. Existing five-category table panel keeps priority for shared pairs; no second ParseBench vote.

panels.label: Table-category tests
panels.note: Exact LlamaIndex rendering/operator cohort; reused baselines remain context-only.

panels.label: Table-cell family
panels.note: 5,386 table_cell checks of cells, headings and neighbours. Not the mixed table-tag slice.

panels.label: Cropped-table T-LAG mean
panels.note: Only parseable predictions scored. Read coverage beside this mean; not end-to-end table extraction.

panels.label: Parseable table coverage
panels.note: Denominator: all 1,820 cropped tables. Not another ranking vote.

layout.label: Layout
layout.title: Layout and reading order · diagnostics
layout.description: No combined layout rating. Reading-order errors, visual grounding and multi-column test performance are different tasks. Compare models within a named column; lower-is-better error metrics retain their original direction.

panels.label: Visual grounding
panels.note: Source-native visual grounding, not reproduced EPR or reading-order accuracy.

panels.label: Multi-column-category tests
panels.note: Document-category test performance; not a pure geometric layout metric.

panels.label: Layout-kind test family
panels.note: Typed block/content association, not reading-order edit distance. Unsupported boxes remain missing.

fields.label: Fields / KIE
fields.title: Field extraction · benchmark-specific evidence
fields.description: No combined field-extraction rating. IDP KIE and NDI extraction are separate vendor-operated protocols, with different tasks and cohorts. These published components do not establish universal field-level F1 or invoice/form accuracy.

panels.label: Key information extraction
panels.note: Vendor-operated IDP Core KIE component; retains its published scale, not a relabeled universal F1.

panels.label: Published extraction component
panels.note: Separate vendor-reported extraction score. Not merged with IDP KIE or used in a global rating.

charts-formatting.label: Charts / formatting
charts-formatting.title: Charts and formatting · benchmark-specific diagnostics
charts-formatting.description: Separate chart-data extraction and semantic-formatting results. No combined rating and no field-level KIE claim. Four-category author evaluations remain separate from five-category published panels.
